description: Source code for accessing SFNT name tables in font files, providing functions to get name count and retrieve specific font name entries.

methods.name: FT_Get_Sfnt_Name_Count
methods.description: Returns the number of SFNT name entries in a font face.

methods.name: FT_Get_Sfnt_Name
methods.description: Retrieves a specific SFNT name entry by index from a font face.
